title: CoPP test could fail when PTF send out packets at a speed beyond the DUT maximum rate limit.
author: keboliu

**Description**

if the PTF sends out the packet at a speed that beyond the maximum limit of the DUT regarding copp,  it could fail some no policer test,  because it’s expecting the received packets recv_count should approximately larger than the 0.9 * send_count. But when the server sends out the packets at a speed exceeding the DUT maximum rate limit,  packets will still be dropped and recv_count will be much smaller than the send_count. comments.author: liat-grozovik
comments.body: @yaxia can you please review and suggest an assignee for the issue?

comments.author: daall
comments.body:
I see this issue as well. I think there are two ways we could go about fixing this:

1. We can skip the check for the absolute recv count. I personally don't feel this is super relevant to the correctness of the test since we are trying to evaluate the policer behavior, not the overall receiving capability of the DUT.
2. We can attempt to limit the sender to some amount ~1000pps or so (enough that there will be a clear difference between the rate-limited traffic and the unlimited traffic). I am still experimenting with different ways to do so to see if this approach is feasible and maintainable.

@keboliu what do you think of these two options?

Summary: [copp] Throttle server send-rate so that DUT does not get overwhelmed
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/3173

### Type of change

<!--
- Fill x for your type of change.
- e.g.
- [x] Bug fix
-->

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
It is possible to have a really strong server that sends too much traffic for the DUT to handle on the non-policer COPP test cases.

#### How did you do it?
I added a short delay between sending packets to try to rate-limit the server speed to approx 2-3 times the COPP rate-limit (note: the rate limit is set at 2000 pps but slower servers may still send slightly less than that). This seems like a sufficient amount to clearly differentiate between the policer working and not working.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test on a variety of server/DUT combinations and it seems to be much more stable than before.
